founder.body: We're building IkiHomes because Costa Rica's real estate market deserves better. Buyers who don't know who to trust with their search. Agents who do great work but have no way to prove it at first contact. IkiHomes exists to solve that — built in Costa Rica, for Costa Rica.
founder.signature: — The IkiHomes Team, San José, Costa Rica

trust_visible.title: Trust will be visible
trust_visible.anchor: We understand that trust isn't declared. It's demonstrated. That's why every signal on IkiHomes is based on real data, not self-promotion.
trust_visible.body: Agents stand out through the signals that matter: responsiveness, activity, and credibility. Your profile will speak for you before you say a word.
trust_visible.badge_zone: Matched to buyers in your zone
trust_visible.img_alt: IkiHomes agent trust card showing response speed badge, verified status and star rating

built_for_cr.title: Built for Costa Rica
built_for_cr.body: Designed for the Costa Rican real estate market, with a local-first approach for agents, buyers, and key zones. Starting with early access in selected areas — and expanding as demand grows.
